description: Course notes the AI TA indexes. Paths are relative to the vault root (the folder above this repo). The files are read in place and never copied.

notes.Midterm Review/00_複習路線圖.md, 01_課堂範圍與來源地圖: Study plans and source maps, not course content; not matched by the include patterns.
notes.Midterm Review/08_*: Practice and past exam questions with worked solutions. Kept out of the index because they are a private evaluation source; indexing them would put the answer key next to the questions.
notes.Week3/Bonus Practice/*: A coding-session transcript and a reflection, not course content; not matched by the include patterns.
notes.exclude_heading_keywords: Self-check sections hold questions with answers that may be used for evaluation. Transcript corrections (逐字稿 sections and 聽成 → 實際對照 tables of misheard terms), source lists, and the midterm notes' 接著讀 (read next) and 來源與整合 (sources) sections are navigation, not content; in a first test they were retrieved and cited as if they supported an answer.
